options.name: value
options.description: Selected day (single mode; not used in range mode).

options.name: selectionMode
options.description: Since 0.3.0. 'range': the first pick sets an anchor, the second completes the range (in either order); value is not used.

options.name: range
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Selected inclusive range in range mode (start <= end).

options.name: minDays
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Range mode: minimum range length in days, counting the first and last day (integer 1-100000); shorter ends are disabled while the anchor is pending.

options.name: maxDays
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Range mode: maximum range length in days, counting the first and last day (integer 1-100000); longer ends are disabled while the anchor is pending.

options.name: visibleMonths
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Consecutive months shown side by side (integer 1-3). Outside days are never shown with more than one month.

options.name: min
options.description: Inclusive lower bound; earlier days are disabled and focus never moves before it.

options.name: max
options.description: Inclusive upper bound.

options.name: isDateDisabled
options.description: Disable individual days (focusable, not selectable).

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Business calendar (since 0.9.0): non-working days and holidays are marked and named in the calendar.

options.name: disableNonWorking
options.description: With businessCalendar: non-working days cannot be picked or typed (since 0.9.0).

options.name: focusedDate
options.description: Initially focused day and visible month. Default: value, else the range start, else today (clamped to min/max).

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: ISO weekday of the first column (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday). Default: the locale's first day of week.

options.name: label
options.description: Grid accessible name. Default: the visible month-year heading (aria-labelledby). With several months each grid is named '{label}, {month}'.

options.name: today
options.description: Advanced: fixed 'today' instead of the current date in timezone (tests, server rendering).

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides; mirrored in RTL.

options.name: showOutsideDays
options.description: Show days of the adjacent months in the first and last week (one visible month only).

options.name: showWeekNumbers
options.description: Show ISO 8601 week numbers as row headers.

options.name: locale
options.description: Heading, weekday names, day numbers, cell names, and first day of week.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Zone used only to determine today.

options.name: direction
options.description: Grid direction and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight mirroring.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: grid
properties.description: The table role=grid of the first visible month.

properties.name: grids
properties.description: Since 0.3.0. All month grids, first to last (one per visible month).

properties.name: range
properties.description: Since 0.3.0. Range mode: the selected range (not the pending anchor).

properties.name: rangeAnchor
properties.description: Since 0.3.0. Range mode: the first picked day while the range is incomplete, else null.

properties.name: focusedDate
properties.description: Day holding the roving tab stop.

properties.name: today
properties.description: Current date in the configured timezone, or the today option.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic selection (no events); a date also becomes the focused day.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. Range mode: programmatic range (no events); a pending anchor is discarded and the first day becomes the focused day.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Show the month of date (scrolling the visible months as needed) and make it the focused day (no events).

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Move DOM focus to the focused day.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; changing range, selectionMode, minDays, or maxDays discards a pending anchor.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: Single mode: the user selected a day (click, Enter, or Space), including re-selecting the current day. Range mode: the user picked the last day; range is the completed range (the first pick emits nothing).

events.name: aui-navigate
events.description: The user changed the visible months (keyboard, month buttons, or an outside day); month is the first visible month.

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar
cssClasses.description: Host; --multi modifier with more than one visible month.

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar__months | __month
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. With several months: flex container (wraps when narrow) and one panel (header and grid) per month.

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar__header | __heading
cssClasses.description: Header and month-year heading (the first heading is a polite live region).

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar__nav | __prev | __next
cssClasses.description: Month navigation buttons (previous in the first header, next in the last).

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar__nav-spacer
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Placeholder for the missing navigation button in inner month headers.

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar__weekday | __week-header | __week-number
cssClasses.description: Column headers and week-number row headers.

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar__day
cssClasses.description: Day gridcell; --today, --selected, --outside, --disabled, --empty modifiers; since 0.3.0 --in-range, --range-start, --range-end, and --preview (pending range) in range mode.
